verdict.rationale: Conductor documents creating a workspace directly from a GitHub or Linear issue, giving each task its own branch and review path. The agent can test and run builds, and Conductor then helps review the diff and open, merge, and archive a pull request, so the product covers issue-to-PR end to end. Missing for 10: detail on whether the issue's contents are automatically fed to the agent as its task, in-depth docs on the PR-creation step itself, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the issue-to-PR flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can turn a tracked issue into a complete pull request end-to-end

citations.quote: create a workspace from a branch, pull request, GitHub issue, or Linear issue
When the work is ready, Conductor helps you review the diff, open a pull request, merge, and archive the workspace.
Each task gets its own workspace, branch, files, terminal, diff, and review path.
The agent can test your repositories, update install and setup scripts, and run builds
